YAC_VERSION (string)
The version of the extension as a string.
YAC_MAX_KEY_LEN (int)
Maximum length of a key in bytes: 48. An instance prefix counts against this limit.
YAC_MAX_VALUE_RAW_LEN (int)
Maximum length of a value before serialization, in bytes: 67,108,863 ((1 << 26) - 1). Larger values are rejected.
YAC_MAX_RAW_COMPRESSED_LEN (int)
Maximum size of a stored entry, in bytes: 1,048,576 (1M). Values that do not fit even after compression are rejected.
YAC_SERIALIZER_PHP (int)
Selected the PHP serializer before Yac 3.0.0. This constant was removed in Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_SERIALIZER_JSON (int)
Selected the JSON serializer before Yac 3.0.0 when Yac was built with JSON support. This constant was removed in Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_SERIALIZER_IGBINARY (int)
Selected the igbinary serializer before Yac 3.0.0 when Yac was built with igbinary support. This constant was removed in Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_SERIALIZER_MSGPACK (int)
Selected the MsgPack serializer before Yac 3.0.0 when Yac was built with MsgPack support. This constant was removed in Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_SERIALIZER (string)
Reported the selected serializer before Yac 3.0.0. This constant was removed in Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_KIND_MISS (int)
The value kind used internally to represent a cache miss. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_KIND_FLAG (int)
The value kind for scalar flags, such as &null; and booleans. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_KIND_LONG (int)
The value kind for integer values stored in a slot. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_KIND_DOUBLE (int)
The value kind for floating-point values stored in a slot. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_KIND_STRING (int)
The value kind for string values. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_KIND_BLOB (int)
The value kind for serialized or compressed values. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_LOC_BLOCK (int)
The value location reported by Yac::dump for a value stored in the value pool. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_LOC_VALWORD (int)
The value location reported by Yac::dump for a scalar value stored in the slot's value word. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_LOC_INLINE (int)
The value location reported by Yac::dump for a short string stored inline in the slot. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_ENC_NONE (int)
The encoder reported by Yac::dump for a value that was not serialized. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_ENC_PHP (int)
The encoder reported by Yac::dump for a value serialized with PHP's native serializer. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
YAC_ENC_YAC (int)
The encoder reported by Yac::dump for a value serialized with Yac's internal serializer. Available as of Yac 3.0.0.
